name: hugo-theme-relearn-infra
description: The test suite and tooling for the Hugo Relearn theme. Nothing here is shipped to theme users.

scripts.test: prettier --check . && node tests/checks.js && node tools/sbom/index.js && node tests/golden.js
scripts.test:update: prettier --write . && node tests/checks.js && node tools/sbom/index.js --update && node tests/golden.js --update
